svg.title: Wall beside the cord channel
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: wall beside the cord channel at 6 mm. Marked in red: 1, the finger lobes: the two rounded lobes in the lower half. 2, the finger lobes and the arms: the two rounded lobes in the lower half; the two toothed arms in the upper half.
